blocks.text: To learn knowledge with the aim of benefiting directly from Allah and of carrying out the commands of Allah in the way of Muhammad ﷺ, (that is, to find out what Allah wants from me at this moment).

blocks.arabic_text: قَالَ اللهُ تَعَالي: (كَمَا أَرْسَلْنَا فِيكُمْ رَسُولاً مِّنْكُمْ يَتْلُوا عَلَيْكُمْ آيتِنَا وَيُزَكِّيكُمْ وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ الْكِتبَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَيُعَلِّمُكُمْ مَّالَمْ تَكُونُوا تَعْلَمُونَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Just as We have sent among you a Messenger from among yourselves, who recites Our verses to you, purifies you, teaches you the Book and wisdom, and teaches you what you did not know (so shall We complete Our favours upon you)

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَأَنْزَلَ اللهُ عَلَيْكَ الْكِتبَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ وَعَلَّمَكَ مَا لَمْ تَكُنْ تَعْلَمُ ؕ وَكَانَ فَضْلُ اللهِ عَلَيْكَ عَظِيماً۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Allah has sent down upon you the Book and wisdom, and He has taught you what you did not know; and the grace of Allah upon you has been immense.
And say (in prayer), “My Rabb, increase me (ever more) in knowledge!”.
